name: aaron_marketing_skills
description: A comprehensive suite of 120 marketing skills and 8 command interfaces designed for Claude Code & AI agents, covering seven key marketing disciplines with integrated auditor gates to ensure quality and performance standards.

inputs.name: marketing_discipline
inputs.description: The specific marketing domain or discipline to apply skills on such as SEO/GEO, influencer marketing, paid ads, email marketing, product launch, organic social media, or brand narrative.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: One of the eight control commands used to invoke specific capabilities or auditing gates like CORE-EEAT, CITE, STAR, ROAS, SEND, RAMP, ECHO, or TALE.

inputs.name: input_data
inputs.description: Relevant data or parameters required by the selected marketing skill or command for processing (e.g., campaign details, SEO keywords, influencer profiles).

outputs.name: marketing_strategy
outputs.description: Generated marketing recommendations, strategies, or action plans tailored to the input discipline and parameters.

outputs.name: audit_report
outputs.description: Evaluation results from applying one of the eight auditor gates, assessing quality, compliance, performance, or impact.

steps: Select the marketing discipline relevant to the campaign or requirement
Invoke one of the 8 commands to trigger a command or auditor gate
Provide necessary input data parameters for the skill or audit
AI agents process the input according to the selected skill and command
Generate marketing strategies or audit reports as outputs
Review and iterate using audit feedback to optimize campaign effectiveness
use_cases: Developing SEO strategies optimized with EEAT and citation validation
Running influencer marketing campaigns with performance auditing
Creating paid advertisements healthcare ROAS-focused audits
Crafting email marketing sequences evaluated for deliverability and engagement
Planning and launching new products with layered marketing insights
Managing organic social media campaigns fine-tuned for brand narrative
Applying brand narrative development with comprehensive story validation
patterns: Use of a shared contract to unify diverse marketing skills and commands
Integration of AI agents like Claude Code for automated execution
Modular audit gates to validate outputs across multiple performance and quality dimensions
Cross-discipline capability layering for comprehensive marketing orchestration

prompt_templates.name: skill_invocation
prompt_templates.template: Apply the {marketing_discipline} marketing skill using command {command} with the following input data: {input_data}.

prompt_templates.name: audit_request
prompt_templates.template: Run the {command} auditor gate to evaluate the marketing output generated for {marketing_discipline} with data: {input_data}.

prompt_templates.name: strategy_development
prompt_templates.template: Develop a marketing strategy for the {marketing_discipline} discipline focusing on optimizing {specific_goal} with inputs: {input_data}.
